thread:
marta: kicking off quota request for a greenfield project in eu-west4. Project id redwood-eu-ml-prod. Need A100 (standard) 8 GPUs, L4 16 GPUs for inference burst, plus 50 external IPs, higher routes per VPC, and Cloud NAT rules. Timeline: staging in 2 weeks, prod in 5 weeks. Can someone validate the numbers and cost estimate? @kevin @lia

kevin: what's the expected sustained qps / gpu hours so we can size reserved vs spot? also any restricted data? :thinking_face:

marta: estimated sustained ~200 qps at ~512 tokens -> ~90k token-hrs/day. Prefer reserved for A100 pool, L4 can be burst on preemptible. No regulated PII in workloads; customer payloads are hashed. Lia can confirm control needs.

lia: confirm no govt/regulated data. we need KMS integration and audit logs forwarded to the retention bucket. also require MTR approval before project creation. cc @sam for SA review.

sam: infra checklist items: org policy allowComputeInstances, firewall baseline, VPC peering to vendor-net, and NAT IP allocation. we'll need 10 Gbps egress cap per VPC and an increase in default route quota. I can provision network once quotas are in.

gcp-quota-bot: SR created: SR-2026-54812. Summary: A100 quota +8, L4 quota +16, External IPs +50, Routes +2000, Cloud NAT rules +5. Initial response ETA 24-48h.

marta: added rough cost estimate: monthly ~= $45k reserved for A100 pool + ~$12k for L4 burst on preemptible. attaching calc in a separate doc.

kevin: please open a support case for Dedicated/Fleet plan as backup (sales needs to be engaged for committed capacity). Also include requested SKUs for Ampere/T4 if they ask.

marta: opened support case: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/12345678 (case created, linked to SR-2026-54812).

lia: approving org-level controls pending KMS key policy and service account email sa-redwood-eu@redwood.com in project IAM. I'll sign off once those are set. :+1:

sam: quick smoke command to validate GPU quota once approved:
```
gcloud compute instances create smoke-a100 --zone=eu-west4-a --machine-type=a2-highgpu-8g --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1
```

marta: noted. tagging @infra-manager for final project approval and gating on security checklist item 7 (KMS).

infra-manager: approved to request GCP project creation and quota increase. Proceed but DO NOT provision until KMS keys and audit forwarding are verified.

gcp-quota-bot: SR-2026-54812 status update: in-progress. Request queued with eu-west4 capacity team, expected internal review 72h.

kevin: fallback plan if eu-west4 capacity delayed: route inference to us-west2 with a model-variant quantized to 4-bit and L4 fallback. Add routing policy and cost guard rails.

marta: adding routing fallback and rollout notes to the runbook. thanks all — will update when SR moves to approved. :rocket:
